params.baseInstructions: Complete the supplied mathematical task using only its explicit inputs and tools. Submit the requested JSON artifact through submit_artifact. Tool feedback is real task feedback; do not invent a successful check. This is a Yui workflow stage. Read the relevant declared Yui rules, preserve the supplied proof route and exact allowed assumptions, and distinguish mathematical review from structural checks.

dynamicTools.name: search_mathlib
dynamicTools.description: 在固定 mathlib 的 Lean 源码中搜索正则表达式，返回至多 100 行。

dynamicTools.name: read_mathlib
dynamicTools.description: 读取固定 mathlib 中一个 Mathlib/...lean 文件的指定行。

dynamicTools.name: read_task_input
dynamicTools.description: Read an explicitly frozen task document by ID; no other local files are accessible.

dynamicTools.name: read_yui
dynamicTools.description: Read declared Yui rules/templates; no tests, historical runs or personal files.

dynamicTools.name: check_artifact
dynamicTools.description: Check a JSON artifact against the explicit stage contract; this is not automatic mathematical certification.

dynamicTools.name: submit_artifact
dynamicTools.description: Submit a JSON artifact after its stage checks.

dynamicTools.name: report_obstacle
dynamicTools.description: Stop this stage honestly on a substantive or suspected proof gap, unavailable source, or input conflict. JSON fields: status, location, explanation, basis, partial_progress. Status must be SUBSTANTIVE_GAP, SUSPECTED_GAP, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or INPUT_CONFLICT. Difficulty alone is not a mathematical error.

dynamicTools.name: probe_library
dynamicTools.description: Query a proved Mathlib theorem and its exact signature/axioms in the offline sandbox. Returns located evidence for an M source; the mathematical statement and applicability still require review.

input.text:
Author structured NL0 v2 for the exact lie-module-irreducibility exercise in the frozen task documents. Read all supplied documents and relevant Yui NL0 authoring, format, self-containment and logical rules through read_yui. The proof-draft is a candidate initial proof, not an audited authority. Preserve its core proof route, expand all nontrivial steps, repair verifiable local errors, and stop with a clearly reported gap if the source route has a substantive gap rather than replacing it with a different research argument. Every theorem used must be a direct H/E/M input or explicitly proved local/internal fact; definitions and calculations cannot hide analysis/algebra theorems. The completed graph must cover arbitrary admissible lattices, lambda=0 and p=2. Outputs must state full mathematical content. Use probe_library for every mathlib M theorem you use. Do not invent source evidence or claim that a theorem merely remembered from training has been source-audited. For the mathematical target and case identity use the frozen source-context. The output is {spec,graph}; mathematical Audit A will run separately with fresh reviewers. You may produce a structurally valid graph with honest identified source qualifications, but must not conceal an unresolved mathematical proof gap inside an input hypothesis.

Submission has exactly {"spec": <NL0 v2 specification>, "graph": <NL0 v2 graph>}. The controller binds spec.inputs to all frozen task documents, pins to the verified runtime, and graph.spec_sha256 to the resulting spec. Supply these fields as placeholders if needed. All mathematical fields remain your responsibility. probe_library returns checked M-source evidence inside this stage case directory; source.statement and hypotheses still need complete mathematical text. A successful check_artifact is structural validation, not Audit A acceptance.
Frozen structural contract: spec.format_version=2; graph.format_version=2; spec.case_id=graph.case_id="lie-module-irreducibility". The controller-bound pins are {"lean_version": "4.32.2", "mathlib_commit": "905b95818eb32af7874a58b427f50c1711a5e96c", "mathlib_root": "/Users/syyui/formalization-tools/lean-mathlib-v4.32.2/mathlib"}. These are provided configuration facts, not guessed mathematical premises. Spec.inputs, spec.pins and graph.spec_sha256 are rebound deterministically, so their placeholder values are not an input conflict. All other required schema fields must be supplied normally.
Exact permitted machine rule names for spec.logic.rules and inference.rules: ["case_elimination", "contradiction_classical", "direct", "exists_elimination", "forall_introduction", "implication_introduction", "modus_ponens", "natural_induction", "negation_introduction"]. Use these identifiers; put mathematical derivations in argument text, not invented rule enum values. Parameters are a list of {symbol,type}; logic is an object {classical,rules,calculations,primitives}. Inferences use R001-style IDs; argument paragraphs use S001-style IDs; propositions use H001/E001/M001/N001 or P. An unknown field/rule is a format repair, not a mathematical gap. Read references/nl0-format.md for every remaining field.
Yui entry: read_yui(path="SKILL.md", start=1, end=200). Available frozen rule paths (relative to rigorous-proof): SKILL.md, references/audit-a.md, references/external-theorems.md, references/isolation.md, references/lean-handoff.md, references/logical-rules.md, references/measurement.md, references/nl0-authoring.md, references/nl0-format.md, references/nl0-stage.md, references/self-containment.md, templates/audit-a.md, templates/authoring.md, translation/references/architecture.md, translation/references/audit-b.md, translation/references/design-notes.md, translation/references/experiments.md, translation/references/integrated-workflow.md, translation/references/obstacle-routing.md, translation/references/shared-lemmas.md, translation/references/source-refactoring.md, translation/references/stage.md, translation/references/translation-rules.md, translation/references/workflow.md, translation/templates/audit-b.md, translation/templates/source-refactoring.md. Every read supports at most 250 lines. Start with the entry and follow its relevant links; do not guess filenames.
Frozen task document IDs: problem.md, proof-draft.json, source-context.md. Use read_task_input to read them.
